title: Getting started with AXYS Creative
description: A simple guide to working with us as we collaborate to build a stunning website for you.
author: Aaron Garcia
body:
## Getting started with a better website

Starting or upgrading a website can feel like a bigger project than it needs to be. Most owners assume they need everything figured out first: branding, messaging, structure, content. In reality, that mindset is what keeps people stuck.

The businesses that make the most progress are not the ones with perfect plans. They start with clarity and build momentum.

### Start with what matters

Before thinking about design or animation, answer one question:

**What is this website supposed to do for your business?**

For most businesses it comes down to one or a mix of these:

- Generate leads
- Book calls
- Sell a product or service
- Build trust and authority

### Keep it moving

1. Agree on the goal
2. Gather the content you already have
3. Review a first version together
4. Refine, then launch

Have a question? [Get in touch](https://axyscreative.com) and we will help you take the first step.
